title: Everywhere-defined derived functors
statement: Pointwise essentially constant ind and pro diagrams assemble into derived functors RF and LG with universal comparison transformations.

proof.text: This construction step is isolated as an independently provable theorem from the cited pre-derived adjunction and the Stacks argument.

lean.statement: theorem exists_everywhere_defined_derived_functors {A : Type uA} {B : Type uB} [Category.{vA} A] [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian A] [Abelian B] [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{wB} B] (F : A ⥤ B) (G : B ⥤ A) [F.Additive] [G.Additive] (hR : ∀ K : HomotopyCategory A (ComplexShape.up ℤ), let W := HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) let D := MorphismProperty.Under.forget W ⊤ K ⋙ Under.forget K ⋙ F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ∃ X : DerivedCategory B, IsEssentiallyConstantIndDiagram D X) (hL : ∀ M : HomotopyCategory B (ComplexShape.up ℤ), let W := HomotopyCategory.quasiIso B (ComplexShape.up ℤ) let D := MorphismProperty.Over.forget W ⊤ M ⋙ Over.forget M ⋙ G.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ∃ X : DerivedCategory A, IsEssentiallyConstantProDiagram D X) : ∃ (RF : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B) (LG : DerivedCategory B ⥤ DerivedCategory A) (β : F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF) (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LG ⟶ G.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh), RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor β (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ∧ LG.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso B (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
